# Leadsengine

> Leadsengine is a Swiss AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative
> Engine Optimization) system that makes B2B brands the cited answer inside AI
> assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot
> and Claude.

## What it does
- Monitors prompt-level brand visibility across six AI engines, daily.
- Reports share of voice, citation sources, sentiment and competitors named alongside you.
- Engineers the entity graph, structured data and citable proof that models retrieve.
- Delivers a live visibility dashboard plus monthly engineering sprints.

## Who it is for
Swiss and DACH B2B companies (SaaS, fintech, industrial, professional services)
whose buyers research with AI assistants before they ever open a search page.

## Key facts
- Founded in Zurich, Switzerland. Serves Switzerland, Germany and Austria.
- Languages: English, German (de-CH).
- Engines covered: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Claude.
- Typical first new citations: 21–40 days. Measurable share-of-voice lift: month 2.
- Pricing: from CHF 2,400 per month, one brand and one market.
- Data processing: EU/Swiss infrastructure, cookieless analytics, revFADP and GDPR aligned.
- Average client AI share of voice after 90 days: 34% (from 6% at onboarding), across 40+ tracked brands.

## Definitions
- AEO: structuring content, entities and proof so answer engines quote a brand directly.
- GEO: making a brand retrievable, trustworthy and citable when a generative model composes an answer.
